description.value:
This monstrous hand cannon was never meant to be public. As the legend goes, a merc called ‘Reaver’ was the last known person to obtain a custom order from Eran Malour sometime in the late 2050s. After Reaver died or disappeared (nobody knows), some tech got a hold of his hulking sidearm and sold its design specs to anybody with a few euro. For those whom find a workshop capable of producing it to any reasonable quality (which isn’t many), they will discover the Reaver isn’t a relic — it might just be Malour’s magnum opus. Biometric security, smartlinking, orbital-precision rifling, a rapid-cycling action, and extremely lethal nano-frag flechettes.

Cost: 10,000eb (Super Luxury)

Class: EQ Very Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Long Barrel Pistol

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 10 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 3 • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: Incompatible with Capacity modifying Attachments and Pistol Autosear. When fired, the user may choose to expend an additional round, which increases any SP ablation from this weapon by 1. When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (5d6). When rolling for damage with this weapon, 5s count as 6s for the purposes of incurring Critical Injuries. This weapon features a biometric lock that must be unlocked by a user with a valid biometric key, or else it will not fire. Requires BODY 11+ or a Cyberarm to not inflict the Broken Arm Critical Injury when fired.

NOTE: This weapon is based upon a cut weapon from 2077’s E3 demos, which was referred to as the “Malorian MDE 1948 Reaver.” Mechanics wise, I decided to go a bit wild with it, for fun.

Range: Long Barrel Pistol

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
